description: Transit - Bus Stops is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. Updated Delaware Transit Information including Bus Stops, Bus Routes, Train Stations, Park and Rides, Park and Pools. Data is updated on a quarterly basis. Coverage: Delaware. The portal files it under the category Transportation. The table has 10 columns. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
